        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.nextLine();
        String line = scanner.nextLine().trim();
        char[] characters = line.toCharArray();

        int[] values = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            values[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        }
        scanner.nextLine();

        List<CharacterInfo> mismatchedChars = new ArrayList<>();
        List<CharacterInfo> charList = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
            if (values[i] > values[n - i - 1]) {
                swap(characters, values, i);
            }
            CharacterInfo ci = new CharacterInfo(characters[i], values[i], i);
            if (characters[i] == characters[n - i - 1]) {
                mismatchedChars.add(ci);
            }
            charList.add(ci);
        }
        charList.sort(Comparator.comparing(c -> c.val));

        int totalDiff = 0;
        if (!isAntiPalindrome(characters)) {
            if (mismatchedChars.size() == 1) {
                CharacterInfo wrongChar = mismatchedChars.get(0);
                for (CharacterInfo ci : charList) {
                    if (ci.chr != wrongChar.chr && characters[n - ci.idx - 1] != wrongChar.chr) {
                        totalDiff = wrongChar.val + ci.val;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } else if (mismatchedChars.size() > 1) {
                Map<Character, Integer> countMap = new HashMap<>();
                for (CharacterInfo ci : mismatchedChars) {
                    countMap.put(ci.chr, countMap.getOrDefault(ci.chr, 0) + 1);
                }
                int maxCount = Collections.max(countMap.values());
                List<CharacterInfo> appendList = new ArrayList<>();
                while (maxCount * 2 > mismatchedChars.size() + appendList.size()) {
                    char maxChar = Collections.max(countMap.entrySet(), Map.Entry.comparingByValue()).getKey();
                    for (CharacterInfo ci : charList) {
                        if (ci.chr != maxChar && characters[n - ci.idx - 1] != maxChar && !mismatchedChars.contains(ci) && !appendList.contains(ci)) {
                            appendList.add(ci);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                totalDiff = mismatchedChars.stream().mapToInt(c -> c.val).sum() + appendList.stream().mapToInt(c -> c.val).sum();
            }
        }
        int sumValues = Arrays.stream(values).sum();
        System.out.println(sumValues - totalDiff);
    }

    private static void swap(char[] chars, int[] vals, int i) {
        char tempChar = chars[i];
        chars[i] = chars[chars.length - i - 1];
        chars[chars.length - i - 1] = tempChar;

        int tempVal = vals[i];
        vals[i] = vals[vals.length - i - 1];
        vals[vals.length - i - 1] = tempVal;

        int len = chars.length;
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            if (chars[i] == chars[len - i - 1]) {
